Team — quick post-call recap from this morning with Ana (procurement) and Luke (head of platform/eco buyer) at PriCorp. High-level: they liked the latency/cost profile we showed; main gating items are security evidence, billing model for reserved capacity, and an exec-level sell-in to their CTO. Notes and immediate asks below.

Key signals
- Economic buyer: Luke Chen (Head of Platform) — cares about unit cost and predictable throughput for batch+real-time paths.
- Security/Procurement: Ana Morales (Procurement & Security intake) — requires SOC2 + data retention/KMS details before legal engages.
- Champion: Product lead (internal advocate) — enthusiastic about performance but needs clear ROI for pilot.

Decision criteria they articulated
1) Predictable monthly cost for pilot (prefer reserved commit)
2) Evidence of SOC2 + data handling policy and KMS options
3) Simple integration pattern (prefix caching + live reranking example)
4) Runbook for failover / fallback to smaller variants

Action items (owner / ETA)
- Olga: short integration diagram + 2-slide technical risk summary (edge cases for PII) — EOD Mon (2/16).
- Stephanie: MAP (mutual action plan) + ROI snapshot for a 3-month pilot with expected token volumes — EOD Fri (2/13). Attachments: ROI_Snapshot and MAP to follow.
- Markus: be ready to consult on contract redlines once Ana confirms legal owners — no immediate action today.
- Me: schedule exec sell-in with Luke + CTO (target week of Mar 1), coordinate procurement call.

Please keep replies tight — want to share the MAP/ROI with Ana by end of week so procurement has something to circulate. I’ll add Ana & Luke once internal draft is ready.

—Jonas
